as_told.title: Battelle behind the scenes at Blue Book's start (Pentacle memo); SAIC and Moultrie ties

plain: This story goes back to Project Blue Book, the US Air Force's study of UFOs in the 1950s and 60s. A UFO investigator, James Fox, says that a researcher named Jacques Vallee, while going through the files of the astronomer J. Allen Hynek, who advised Blue Book, came upon a classified document he was never meant to see. According to Fox, it was a letter from Battelle, a private research institute, signed by a man named H.C. Cross. Fox and a podcast host, Jesse Michels, say it points to a secret UFO program running alongside the public one. Michels calls the document the Pentacle memo and says Battelle was working behind the scenes from the very start of Blue Book. In one telling he leaves out Vallee and instead ties the story to present-day defense contractors and to officials named Sean Kirkpatrick and Ronald Moultrie. If true, it would mean the public UFO study was only part of the picture, with the real work done in secret.
